title: Frontend Developer Roadmap
summary: Build from HTML/CSS/JavaScript fundamentals into accessible, responsive, tested frontend applications, then develop depth in performance, architecture and design systems.

facts.Timeline assumption: Four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme beginning in 2026 and ending around 2030.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Become capable of building responsive, accessible, tested frontend applications and deploying them publicly.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Develop depth in React/TypeScript, design systems, performance, accessibility or frontend architecture.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Own frontend architecture, complex applications, developer experience and cross-functional delivery.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine frontend expertise with web-platform knowledge, AI-assisted development, architecture and leadership.

PhD routes

Senior frontend work increasingly involves architecture, performance, accessibility, security, design systems and technical strategy. Maintain deep browser and web-platform knowledge while learning new frameworks and AI-assisted development methods as they become useful.
